name: wet
description: Open-source MCP server for AI agents: web search, content extraction, and library docs.

WET_URL.title: wet server URL (optional)
WET_URL.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint of a running wet instance (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp). Start one with `uvx --python 3.13 --from wet-mcp wet server start` or docker compose.

WET_TOKEN.title: wet bearer token (optional)
WET_TOKEN.description: Shared bearer token when the instance uses auth = "token" / "multi"; leave empty for a loopback no-auth instance.
